significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that the “knowledge axis lies approximately in the span of belief and truth and fires most strongly when both are positive,” a form-(iii) geometric conjunction and predictive coupling rather than merely the existence of three decodable features. It would supply both a phenomenon—the conjunction’s strength predicts factivity failures—and a mechanistic account in which failure to separate belief from truth explains the behavioral confusion documented in “Language models cannot reliably distinguish belief from knowledge and fact”; this also constrains how truth directions such as those studied in Marks and Tegmark’s “The Geometry of Truth” should interact with attributed belief. Verified false would determinately rule out the simple internal knowledge-as-belief-AND-truth account, although it would not by itself choose among independent-axis, lexical, or stronger-belief alternatives. After topic substitution, generic research on internal LLM beliefs would not earn this score: the specific span/conjunction relation and its predicted coupling to factivity errors are what raise it above the topic-median distinct-axis hypothesis.

reach.justification: The named handle is “a diagnostic for which of the three axes a given model has failed to separate,” supplemented by the proposed conjunction score linking belief, truth, and knowledge activations; it is principally a model-level post-hoc diagnostic, though the claimed prediction of factivity failures could provide an action window before broader deployment. After per-model re-extraction, the conclusion would still predict a transferable relation—knowledge should lie near the belief/truth span and strengthen when both scores are positive—rather than merely prescribing a search for an unconstrained new direction. The hypothesis is framed across LLMs and connects axis separation to model-level factivity behavior, making interpretability researchers and potentially model auditors downstream users, but it does not specify a deployment gate, universal scaling law, or uptake outside AI. The topic-substitution check lowers no further: “LLM beliefs” alone supplies neither this three-axis diagnostic nor the conjunction relation, which is the claim-specific basis for reach above the median probe-and-steer deliverable.
